text: Attempt the below(compulsory) Sunrise Bank, a mid-sized private sector bank with a strong presence in tier-1 and tier-2 cities experienced stagnating growth and declining CASA deposits due to aggressive competition from digital-first banks and fintech platforms. While the bank had a sound balance sheet and a loyal base of SME and salaried customers, its legacy IT systems and paperwork-heavy processes resulted in delayed loan approvals and limited customer engagement. Recognizing the rapid shift toward digital financial services, the management introduced a comprehensive transformation program titled “Sunrise SmartBank Initiative.” The program aimed to reposition the bank as a digitally agile and customer-centric institution. Sunrise Bank launched a next-generation mobile banking application featuring instant account opening real-time personal loan approvals using automated credit scoring, QR-based merchant payments, and integrated wealth management services. It also introduced biometric authentication for secure transactions and AI-driven financial advisory tools that provided personalized savings and investment recommendations. Furthermore, the bank collaborated with e-commerce platforms to offer embedded credit options at checkout, enabling customers to access short-term financing seamlessly. Despite the promising outlook, Sunrise Bank faced multiple operational and strategic challenges during implementation. Employees accustomed to traditional banking practices showed resistance to adopting digital workflows, while customers in semi-urban areas needed assistance in adapting to app-based services. Concerns regarding cybersecurity threats, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance further intensified the pressure on management. To overcome these barriers, Sunrise Bank established a dedicated digital transformation team implemented multi-layer cybersecurity controls, and launched customer awareness campaigns promoting safe digital banking practices. You are being head of digital transformation team, required to formulate awareness campaign briefing about innovative banking services along with recent emerging trends in banking industry.
